notes: «حدثني جدي الحصين بن عبد الرحمن» and «عن جده عمرو بن سعد» are one link each (rule 7); «عن أبيه» is bare kinship (relation); the Imam is named after «عن» inside the chain, so narrator; the title «أمير المؤمنين» is not part of the surface; the report number «3» is dropped
